answer: A lotus-seed proof binds the stake to a unique verified human, while peers cross-check an echo of prior attestations to catch duplicates. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is a bonded identity spiral: each new agent must stake escalating collateral that grows with every linked registration, so registering many fake identities costs exponentially more than one honest join. Attackers must burn real capital across every fake node, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0050's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
